intelligence.essence: The orbs are aligned to the gauges — but sometimes when you switch in and out they don't stay aligned. They must stay aligned, every switch, every tap, every return, with no reload to rescue them.
intelligence.simple_view: Imagine nine shiny marbles sitting in a perfect circle — and every time you tap one, the circle squishes! The marbles need to stay in their perfect circle no matter how many times you tap them, sweetheart.
intelligence.grandma_view: It's like this, love — the pretty jewels on the Dashboard sit in a lovely line, dear, but when you tap one they all crowd together, love, and they don't go back unless you start all over. They need to stay in their line, dear — every tap, every time you come back. That's how a beautiful thing behaves, love.
